lines.text: Many learners say: I came lately to class.
Better: I came late to class.
Late! I came late to work.

native.tip: Kita bilang “Saya datang terlambat.” tanpa akhiran apa pun. Dalam bahasa Inggris juga cukup late, tanpa -ly. Lately artinya belakangan ini.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I came lately to class.” 😅 Untuk terlambat, pakai late: “I came late to class.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “late”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I came late to class.” lalu tulis satu kalimat tentang kapan kamu terlambat. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Saya datang terlambat.” with no ending. In English, just say late, with no -ly. Lately means recently.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I came lately to class.” 😅 For terlambat, use late: “I came late to class.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
